📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Tomás Baker and Wren Cohen will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Dmitri Lindqvist and Ellis Baker will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Alba Baker and Oscar Lund and Talia Sato and Darius Kowalski and Elena Marsh and Darius Dubois will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
